blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Match each equation with its solution. Check each one by putting the answer back.
blocks.display: Match each equation with its solution.

blocks.text: Subtract one to get two x equals eight, then divide by two: x is four.
Add five to get three x equals fifteen, then divide by three: x is five.
Subtract two to get five x equals negative ten, then divide by five: x is negative two.
Divide both sides by four to get x minus one equals five, then add one: x is six.
All four are matched. Each answer works when you put it back into its equation.
